title: Equipment-Age Refund Share Table for Harbison Labor-Only Protection Cancellations
content:
**Rule.** On the cancellation of a Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection or Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, an equipment-age refund share applies by multiplication to the contract price in the refund. It is set by the whole calendar months from the installed date of the Harbison installation named on the contract — the installation record under Replacement System Installations — or from the coverage start where the contract names none, to the date of confirmation.

| Whole calendar months from the installed date (or coverage start) to the date of confirmation | Equipment-age refund share |
|---|---|
| more than 120 months | 0.80 |
| more than 60 and up to 120 months | 0.90 |
| 60 months or fewer | 1 |

**Both sides of each threshold.**

| Months | Share |
|---|---|
| 60 | 1 |
| 61 | 0.90 |
| 120 | 0.90 |
| 121 | 0.80 |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** Installed date 5 October 2015; confirmation on 4 November 2025 is 120 whole months (the 121st completes on 5 November 2025): share 0.90. Confirmation on 5 November 2025: 121 months, share 0.80.
